definition.description: The New York Heart Association (NYHA) functional classification of heart failure.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the reported NYHA class (I, II, III, or IV) from the patient's pretreatment clinical notes, typically associated with descriptions of dyspnea and exercise tolerance.
definition.missing_value_rule: Report as null if no NYHA class is documented or if the documentation is too ambiguous to assign a specific class.
definition.name: nyha_class

definition.description: The professional status of the patient's occupation.
definition.measurement_definition: Categorize the patient's occupation as 'Professional' if they have a professional job title (e.g., healthcare provider, engineer, educator), otherwise categorize as 'Other'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Unknown' if the occupation is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: occupation

definition.description: The current clinical management phase of a patient under oncology care.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the stated status of oncology management from the pretreatment record, identifying whether the patient is undergoing active treatment, is in a routine follow-up or surveillance phase, or is not under oncology management.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent absent or ambiguous documentation as 'Unknown'.
definition.name: oncology_management_status

definition.description: Whether the patient is using or has been prescribed ondansetron as an antiemetic.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if ondansetron is listed in the patient's current medications, mentioned as being continued in progress notes, or prescribed in the treatment plan for nausea/vomiting prophylaxis or treatment.
definition.missing_value_rule: Absent documentation or lack of mention of ondansetron in the medication list and plan is represented as 'No'.
definition.name: ondansetron_use

definition.description: Presence of abnormal contrast enhancement of the optic chiasm on MRI.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the post-contrast T1-weighted imaging report indicates the presence or absence of abnormal enhancement of the optic chiasm.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the optic chiasm is not mentioned or the documentation regarding its enhancement is ambiguous.
definition.name: optic_chiasm_enhancement

definition.description: Presence of abnormal contrast enhancement of the optic nerves on neuroimaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the radiology report mentions 'abnormal enhancement' or 'enhancement' of the optic nerves. 'No abnormal enhancement' or 'unremarkable' optic nerves indicate absence; 'abnormal enhancement' or 'enhancing' optic nerves indicate presence.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the optic nerves are not mentioned or if the report does not specify the presence or absence of enhancement.
definition.name: optic_nerve_enhancement

definition.description: The qualitative appearance of the orbital fat as described in neuroimaging reports.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the described status of the orbital fat from the radiology report (e.g., 'within normal limits', 'normal', 'abnormal', or descriptions of stranding/infiltration).
definition.missing_value_rule: If orbital fat appearance is not mentioned or is ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: orbital_fat_appearance

definition.description: The presence or absence of organ enlargement (organomegaly) in the patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether organomegaly is documented as present or absent from the pretreatment clinical records, including radiology reports and physical examination notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if organomegaly is not mentioned in the documentation.
definition.name: organomegaly_presence

definition.description: Presence of osteoarthritis at the time of the pretreatment record.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if osteoarthritis (OA) is listed in the patient's past medical history, comorbidity list, or mentioned within the musculoskeletal review of systems (e.g., 'osteoarthritis of knees', 'mild knee OA pain').
definition.missing_value_rule: If osteoarthritis is not documented or is explicitly denied, it is represented as 'Absent'.
definition.name: osteoarthritis_presence

definition.description: Presence of osteopenia as diagnosed by clinical record or DEXA scan.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if osteopenia is explicitly documented in the pretreatment medical records, typically found in the comorbidities section, diagnostic reports, or noted as a result of a DEXA scan.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if there is no mention of osteopenia or DEXA scan results in the record.
definition.name: osteopenia

system:
You review pretreatment candidate measurements using modeling evidence
from one outer-training fold. First identify themes across candidates; then
reconcile their roles as confounder, effect_modifier, both, or neither.
All evidence is fallible. No individual family, p-value, or support frequency is
a hard selection gate. A credible complementary signal can justify retention
even when other methods shrink it away. Do not mistake correlated aliases or
proxies for multiple independent discoveries. Themes organize evidence; they
do not establish equivalence, merge measurements, or transfer a role to every
theme member. Preserve investigator-locked roles exactly.

Treatment prediction, outcome prognosis, and confounding are distinct. Discuss
whether a candidate could be a common cause rather than an instrument or only a
prognostic factor. Effect modification needs treatment-heterogeneity evidence;
outcome main-effect importance alone does not establish it. Univariable logistic
interactions are on the log-odds scale and unadjusted for other covariates.
Orthogonal linear models, candidate R-learners, and causal forests assess the
probability/outcome scale after elastic-net nuisance adjustment. Their targets
and biases differ. A model family is evidence, not an independent replication.

Use exposure and evaluability denominators. Missing or nonconverged fits are not
negative votes. Repeated samples and folds overlap; support fractions are not
causal probabilities or formal stability-selection error guarantees. Raw and BH
p-values do not correct the upstream adaptive discovery process. Permutation
importance can be diluted by correlated alternatives and does not prove a
causal role. Compare fold consistency, methods, subsets, and conflicting facts.
Definitions and theme names cannot establish a role without the supplied
empirical evidence. Never invent an oracle, data-generating process, or hidden
truth. Return the requested JSON and cite only supplied evidence IDs.
